claims.claim_text: Exact private-identifier agreement confirms the indexed Carmel D Boyle identity in the official Army merged file.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The index and Army record share the exact private identifier and matching full name; the Russel/Russell spelling difference is preserved where applicable.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed through exact private-identifier and name agreement across official records.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army record dates entry to 1942-01-06; it does not establish the later Army-to-OSS assignment date.
claims.match_notes: The full identifier remains masked publicly. Private-at-entry grade does not imply the later OSS role.

claims.evidence_paraphrase: Code 316 was recorded at Army entry on 1942-01-06 and maps to farm hands, general farms.

claims.temporal_assessment: Strongly date-bounded at Army entry; not a named employer and not proven to be the immediate predecessor to OSS.
claims.match_notes: No employer, workplace, exact trade, location, duties beyond the broad code, or Army-to-OSS sequence is inferred.
